story.label: our story
story.headline: for the days your mind gets sensitive before your skin does.
story.body1: people, pings, all day long. some days it’s not your skin that needs a break first.

consent.title: [optional] analytics and ad measurement
consent.body: we count which pages get seen to improve the site and our ads. if you allow it, google and meta analytics tools use cookies.
disclosures: purpose: site usage analytics, ad performance measurement
data: pages viewed, taps, how you arrived, device and browser info, cookie ids (_ga, _fbp), and order number, item count and amount when you buy
recipients and country: google llc (usa), meta platforms, inc. (usa)
when and how: sent right away by cookies and tags while you use the site
kept for: google analytics 2 months, meta up to 2 years
saying no doesn't limit your shopping. you can change this anytime under 'cookie settings' at the bottom of the home page.
